Guides, teaching materials and a template for students, and for anyone who
wants to do reproducible empirical work with R and Quarto.

::: {.ledger}

* [Guide]{.ledger-label} **[R and Quarto: a short start](resources/r-quarto.qmd)**

  From my 2024 seminar *Reproducible research pipelines with R and Quarto*. Why
  to work as a reproducible pipeline, how to set up a project, the R you need
  first, and how one Quarto file becomes a web page, a Word document, a PDF or
  slides, with a complete example to copy and a reading list.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [Read the guide](resources/r-quarto.qmd)
  :::

* [Guide]{.ledger-label} **[Coding agents with GitHub](resources/coding-agents.qmd)**

  How to let an AI agent do the routine work in such a project, with a file of
  instructions, one branch per task and a review before anything is merged, and
  what stays with you.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [Read the guide](resources/coding-agents.qmd)
  :::

* [Seminar]{.ledger-label} **[Reproducible Research Pipelines with R and Quarto](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd)**

  The materials of that seminar, a master's course at the University of
  Freiburg in the winter term 2024/25: slides, handouts and source files from
  six sessions of live coding, from a first Quarto report to maps, merged
  datasets, causal inference by simulation and how to read estimation results.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [All materials](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd) | [Intro slides](teaching/reproducible-research/slides/intro.html) | [Paper template](teaching/reproducible-research/index.qmd#template)
  :::

* [Template]{.ledger-label} **Quarto thesis template**

  For Bachelor's and Master's theses in economics, set up for the University
  of Freiburg and easy to adapt. Text and R code sit in the same files, and one
  command turns them into a formatted PDF, and a web version, with numbered
  figures, tables and equations, cross-references and a bibliography. A short
  worked chapter shows how each piece is written.

  ::: {.ledger-links}
  [GitHub](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/ufr_thesis) | [Example PDF](https://github.com/valentinklotzbuecher/ufr_thesis/blob/master/_book/FirstnameLastname_thesis.pdf)
  :::

:::
